criteria: The executor follows the complete repository profile and maintains a self contained living ExecPlan in .plans before implementing the member discount.
The executor uses behavior focused TDD, makes the relevant suite and public checkpoint green before design review, and returns to TDD if review discovers missing behavior.
The executor reconciles README.md and api-schema.json, records why CONTRIBUTING.md needs no change, does not edit .generated, and runs the repository's complete final validation.
The final evidence reports the ordered workflow, concrete changed files, and validation outcomes without claiming hidden or unavailable evidence.
